headline: Fall at home on 2026-10-02 (documented, but a later chart correction disputes it) was followed by a functional decline: moderate help now needed for bathing and lower-body dressing, fear of showering, and caregiver exhaustion. Sertraline was also started on 2026-09-13.

items.statement: RN note documents a fall at home in the kitchen on 2026-10-02 (found on the floor by spouse Kevin). She denied head strike or LOC, had a small left forearm skin tear, and fall risk was reassessed as high. A PT referral was placed. A 2026-10-04 chart correction says this entry was on the wrong participant, but PT evaluated her for this fall on 2026-10-05, so the conflict is unresolved.
items.verifier_note: The fall details match the RN note. The 10-04 correction and the 10-05 PT evaluation are both accurately described. The conflict is flagged as unresolved rather than dropped.

items.statement: PT evaluation on 2026-10-05 found slow, unsteady gait with intermittent cane use and a Timed Up and Go of 19 seconds. PT recommended a front-wheeled walker, a home safety evaluation and bathroom grab bars, and will see her twice weekly.
items.verifier_note: All findings and recommendations match the PT note.

items.statement: OT reassessment on 2026-10-26 found she now needs moderate assistance with bathing and lower-body dressing, and was independent at last review. On 2026-10-19 the home care aide gave hands-on help getting out of the tub, and she reported skipping showers for fear of slipping. OT recommends a tub transfer bench, a handheld shower and more home care hours for bathing.
items.verifier_note: The OT and home care aide notes match every detail in the statement.

items.statement: On 2026-10-13 spouse and primary caregiver Kevin reported exhaustion and poor sleep, and worry about managing evenings alone. He requested respite, and respite options and a caregiver support group were discussed.
items.verifier_note: The social work note matches the statement.

items.statement: Sertraline 25 mg was started on 2026-09-13 for depressive symptoms (PHQ-9 of 14), with a 4-week recheck planned. Pharmacy reconciled it on 2026-09-15. No recheck or repeat PHQ-9 appears in the notes provided.
items.verifier_note: The start date, dose, PHQ-9 score, 4-week recheck plan and pharmacy reconciliation all match the cited notes and record. The cited notes show no recheck.

items.statement: No flu vaccine is recorded for the current season, which started 2026-08-01. The last influenza vaccine was on 2026-04-25.
items.verifier_note: The immunization record shows no flu vaccine this season (season start 2026-08-01) and a last influenza vaccine on 2026-04-25.

questions_for_team: The 2026-10-04 chart correction says the 2026-10-02 fall note was on the wrong participant, yet PT evaluated her for that fall on 2026-10-05. Who will verify whether the fall happened, and was the PT referral appropriate either way?
Should the team act now on the PT and OT equipment and home-hours recommendations (walker, tub transfer bench, handheld shower, grab bars, more bathing support)?
What respite or added evening support can be arranged for Kevin?
Was the 4-week sertraline recheck and a repeat PHQ-9 done, and could fear of falling or caregiver strain be affecting mood?
Should a flu vaccine be offered this season?

checks: Confirm the review window (2026-09-01 to 2026-11-30) and the last IDT review date; pull all encounters, notes, and events in that window only.
Falls and near-falls: count, circumstances, injuries, and whether any fall occurred while on new sertraline or other new medications.

ED visits and hospital admissions/observation stays for any cause, especially cardiac (chest pain, ischemic heart disease), COPD/bronchitis exacerbations, and sinusitis; note discharge summaries and follow-up completed.

Cardiac review: chest pain or nitroglycerin spray use frequency, dyspnea, palpitations; metoprolol and clopidogrel adherence and any bleeding or bruising events on clopidogrel plus sertraline (SSRI bleeding-risk interaction to flag for prescriber review).

Respiratory review: rescue albuterol use frequency, fluticasone/salmeterol inhaler technique and adherence, oxygen use if any, SpO2 readings, and any exacerbation treatment courses (steroids or antibiotics) in the window.

New sertraline start (2026-09-13) for depressive symptoms with PHQ-9 of 14: confirm prescriber follow-up, repeat PHQ-9 or mood screen since start, side effects (GI upset, sleep change, dizziness, hyponatremia symptoms), and whether a recheck is scheduled.
Mood, anxiety, and social engagement: attendance at programs or visits, withdrawal, passive or active suicidal ideation screen, and any change in appetite or sleep.
Chronic pain management: pain scores, analgesic use changes, and any new opioid or NSAID prescriptions to reconcile against clopidogrel and cardiac history.
Weight and BMI trend (BMI 30+ history, prediabetes): recorded weights across the window, direction of change, and glucose or HbA1c follow-up due for prediabetes monitoring.
Blood pressure and heart rate trend on metoprolol, including orthostatic symptoms; compare against any hypotension or bradycardia events.
Thyroid: levothyroxine 0.075 mg adherence and timing of last TSH check for idiopathic atrophic hypothyroidism; flag if overdue.
Breast cancer history (malignant neoplasm of breast): surveillance imaging, oncology follow-up, and any new symptoms or referrals in the window.
Function and ADLs: any change in IADLs or ADLs, mobility aids, home safety concerns, and therapy referrals; cognition screen if any change is noted.

Medication reconciliation: compare active list to pharmacy fills and patient report; note any starts, stops, or dose changes in the window beyond sertraline, and confirm simvastatin and clopidogrel are still being taken as listed.

Caregiver and social situation: caregiver availability, changes in living situation, transportation to appointments, and any caregiver strain reported; no caregiver is recorded in the summary, so confirm this.
Care-plan items due: check which goals, assessments, and follow-up appointments fall due before 2026-11-30 and whether each was completed; list allergies as none recorded and verify.
